spec.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
spec.summary: Build a Trie class for lowercase words.
spec.description: Build a Trie class for lowercase words. Its constructor creates an empty structure; insert stores a word; search reports whether the complete word was inserted; startsWith reports whether any inserted word begins with a prefix. A prefix alone need not be a stored word.
constraints: Words and prefixes contain lowercase English letters only.
At most 3 * 10^4 total calls to insert, search, and startsWith.

examples.explanation: The shorter prefix exists as a path but was never inserted as a complete word.

approaches.name: Character Trie
approaches.summary: Give each character a path node and mark nodes that end inserted words.
thinkingSteps: Create a root with no stored word.
On insert, follow or create one child for each character, then mark the final node.
On search and startsWith, follow the path; search also checks the end marker.

bullets: The same prefixes are checked again and again.
A prefix can exist even when it is not a complete stored word.
The interface needs both exact-word and prefix queries.
